content: Emanuel-danikoed-e-wilubgangi sunmaklenaid
Deunni, Rey-Acaz Judá-yargi negsemaid. Acazʼde Jotam-e-machid, degi, Uzías-e-wagwabalid. A-we-reymar-warbogwad Jerusalén-neggwebur sussurgusmalad.

Weyob Rey-David-negga-gusadse gayaburba nonikid: Siria-dulemar Efraín-dulemarbo atosmarye. Degi, Rey-Acaz nue-dobe itonaded. E-neggweburginmalad bela dobedba wawanmakdemalad. Igi-sapimar burwaba banamakgwisdae, ayobi wawanmakdemalad.

Geb degi, Bab-Jehová Isaíasʼga sogded: “Be-machi-Sear-Jasubʼbo, Acaz-abinguega be nae. Bia dii-gammu-maid dii-wilad-dummad-siid-akar dii-sedanidae, a-bergunaid-nagaba be abinguoed. We-dii-gammude, mor-odidued-neg-igar-nalemaidsik maid.

Acazʼga be sogo: ” ‘¡Nue salakalo! ¡Melle be dobguo! Siria-rey-Rezín-sabsur-urwed-abin, melle be gwayo. Remalías-machi-Peka-abin, melle be gwayebalo. We-dulemar-warbogwad-abin melle be gwage-nunmak-itogo. We-reymar-warbogwad unnila, igi soogi-waa-ainakwialir yog berguar-naddae, ayobi gumalad.’
”Acazʼga be sogbalo: ‘Efraín-dulemar Remalías-machi-Pekaʼmala, Siria-dulemarbo, bemar-wiogega na atosmalad.
Ar ade, sogsamalad: Anmar Judá-yalagi gwisgunae, anmar e-dulemar ogwayenae, anmar we-yala e-ibe suoed, geb anmar agi Tabeel-machi reyga omesoed.’
”A-ukinbali, Acazʼga be sogbalo: ‘Ani Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob sogbarye:

content.text: Ar bemar angi benmalale, bemar wegi ambikuosurmalad.’ ”

content: Mesías-gwalulegoed-e-wilub
Bab-Jehová, Acazʼga sogdebalid:
—An be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-gued. Anse wilubga-guega ibmar-gegerdakleged-imaked be egise. Sunna bega ibmar-gegerdakleged nibneg-birigi imakodibe, bela-bela napa-uluse imakodibe.
Acaz abin-sogded: —Bab-Jehová, an be-wilubdakosulid. An bese bipisaale ibmar egisosulid.
Geb degi, Isaías sogded: “Emisgine, bemar, David-wagan, nue be an-itomalo. ¿Ar be dulemar-ourwed nubin be itosursi? Ar emide be, deyob an-Bab-Dummad-ourwebimarmogad.
A-ulale, Bab-Jehová-sunnagwad ibmar-guoed-e-wilub oyogoed: Yagwa-wargwen gurgin-nika guoed, degi, goe nikunonikoed. Emanuelʼye onugsaoed.
Goe achanisbi madii guoed, moli-nunis-ollikwagwadbi madii gubaloed. Mag-neg-itogusadse we-ibmarmar indakoed.
Ar mimmi-mag-neg-itoged-iduale, igid ibmar-nuedi, igid-ibmar-ichakwabali, reymar-warbogwad-ese-be-gwayediidi, e-yalamar bela ibitomaloed.”
Judá-yargi sabsur-ubononikoedgi sunmaklenaid

Isaías, Acazʼga sogbalid: “Bab-Jehová, Judá-yargine Asiria-e-rey barmidagoed. Begine, be-dulemargine, degi, be-wagangine, ibagan-bulegan barmidagoed. Efraín-yala, Judá-yalagi-bangusad-akale, a-ibmarmar-gwen-dakledsulidi, begi barmidagoed.”
A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová, Egipto-sorda-diwar-dukuba-dikasur-bukmaladse wigooed. Amala gukurmaryobi bemarse barmidagoed. Degi, Asiria-yalagi-bukmaladse wigobaloed. Bemarse burmaryobi barmidagoed.
Amar bela nonimaloed, ibe-dummagan-imbaganba ambikunonimaloed, akwasaila-ollogana-yaba ubononimaloed, gagan-moodo-ikoyaisur-naidgi bukunonimaloed, molimar-dii-gobmalad-nagaba ambikunonimaloed.

A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová, Asiria-e-reyga Éufrates-diwar-obakar-Israel-dulemar-bukmalad-sabsur-odurdakega urmakoed. Bela e-sailagia swanga imaklegoed, bela e-sigamala, ei immilegoed, alu-sigase-bakale ei immilegoed. Bela-bela-wilemalaga imaklegoed.
A-ibagangine, dule-wargwen moli-bebe-nikad-bunolo-wargwen wis akwedii guoed, sibad-ome-warbo wis akwedii gubaloed.
We-ibmar-durgan ega nunis-bukidar nika guoed, e-nunis-ollikwagwad-madii guoed. Dule-we-yargi-bemaloedi, unnitiba moli-nunis-ollikwagwad achanisba madii gumaloed.
A-ibaganginbali, uva-nainugi uva-miligwen-digar-naigusadi (1,000), mani-sibu-miligwen-gargegus-gusadi, emidi ikomar-nainuga guoed, degi, gagan-ikobimalad-nainuga guoed.
Bela yala iko-sunnabi naguoed. A-sapurgi, warsibi-annika nanadii gumaloed, sigubi-annika nanadii gumaloed.

Gebe-iduale, a-yala-mullugangi memed-weregedgi ibmar-nabir digledaenad. Emisgindi, ikomar-dobedba, gagan-ikomar-dobedba, bar dule ese warmakosulid. Unnila, we-gaganmar, moli-bebe-nikad-e-masga, sibad-wawaadmar-e-masga guoed.
